rationale: This study is a laboratory biochemistry and microbiology investigation isolating bacterial cell wall receptors from Gluconacetobacter diazotrophicus that bind sugarcane glycoproteins. It is completely unrelated to household or community water or sanitation service access (E01) and examines no legal, administrative, regulatory, or governance mechanism or access outcome.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both readings because the study is a biochemistry paper on bacterial cell wall receptors and sugarcane glycoproteins with no relation to water, sanitation, or governance.

evidence_quotes.quote: Isolation from Gluconacetobacter diazotrophicus cell walls of specific receptors for sugarcane glycoproteins, which act as recognition factors
Glycoproteins from sugarcane stalks have been isolated from plants field-grown by size-exclusion chromatography.
